name: autovideo
description: App desktop sản xuất video theo cảnh (Windows, Tauri)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server && npm run typecheck -w worker
scripts.build:app: node scripts/build-win.mjs && tauri build --no-bundle && node scripts/build-installer.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w worker
